data.purpose: Run IDs, paths, and raw evidence.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #171717); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #171717); border-radius: 2px; padding: 7px 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #333; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #171717); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: Scoped search for cells or runs.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="Filter runs" aria-label="Filter runs">
components.css: .ds-search { background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #171717); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b8b8b8); border-radius: 2px; padding: 6px 9px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #171717; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Black global rail with an in-rail chevron that compresses the navigation to 52px.
components.html: EvalsRuns
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; background: #171717; padding: 12px; } .ds-nav button { background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 0; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; } .ds-nav a { color: #bdbdbd; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 2px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: #2e2e2e; color: #fff; } .ds-nav a.ds-active { background: #343434; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; }

components.name: Status label
components.description: Textual verdict in black and white.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; padding: 2px 6px; background: #ededed; color: #171717; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Work surface
components.description: Flat ruled frame around filters or evidence.
components.css: .ds-surface { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 2px; color: #171717; padding: 14px; }

narrative.overview: A black-and-white results workspace, not an eval showcase or themed AI control room. Typography and one-pixel dividers establish hierarchy; the navigation compresses to a slim rail, while trial evidence stays connected to the run table in a contextual panel.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: No visual treatment should imply a score, state, or comparison not recorded in the actual reports.

dos: Privilege saved run identity, status, eval and trial evidence over decorative summaries.
Retain keyboard-accessible navigation and clear focus in dense layouts.
Show report states in text, never just tint.
donts: Add invented metrics or a published-eval gallery to the operations screen.
Reintroduce green accents, gradient chrome, faux marks, or a hero-metric strip.
Hide table columns simply to make a phone capture look tidy.
